subject: CHEM
title: General Chemistry 2
description: Properties of liquids and solutions. Introduction to chemical equilibria. Principles of acid‑base equilibria, solubility and electrochemical processes. Chemical kinetics.
notes: Science students must also take CHEM 123L; offered in W, S terms

subject: CHEM
title: Introductory Spectroscopy and Structure
description: The nature of electromagnetic radiation and an elementary outline of quantum mechanics in one dimension. For each of microwave, infrared, Raman, electronic, photoelectron, and nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, the nature of the molecular energy levels involved and the type of molecular information that can be obtained using it are examined.

subject: CHE
title: Engineering Biology
description: Introduction to molecular biology concepts relevant to chemical engineering. Topics include cell structure, proteins, nucleic acids, metabolism, enzyme kinetics, and genetic regulation.
notes: Typically taken in 1B term by Chemical Engineering students

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Engineering Computation
description: Application of numerical methods and computer programming to solve chemical engineering problems. Includes linear algebraic equations, nonlinear equations, ordinary differential equations, and optimization.

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics 1
description: The first and second laws of thermodynamics, properties of pure substances, thermodynamic cycles, and applications to energy systems.

subject: CHE
title: Chemical Engineering Fluid Mechanics
description: Fluid statics and dynamics, flow in pipes and channels, dimensional analysis, and fluid machinery. Emphasis on applications to chemical engineering systems.

subject: CHE
title: Transport Processes 1
description: Fundamentals of momentum, energy, and mass transport. Introduction to the differential formulation of transport phenomena with applications to chemical engineering systems.
